name: Drupal Forge Deployment
description: Prepare Drupal Forge launch URLs from backup and repository metadata.
project_description:
Drupal Forge Deployment integrates with Drupal Forge to help you launch a copy of your Drupal site. The module handles database export, Git repository detection, and generates a launch URL with all required parameters.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Your Drupal site must have:

 
 Drupal 8 or higher 
 A Git repository with a GitHub or GitLab remote 
 Backup and Migrate module with AWS S3 destination configured 
 
 Back to top 

 Getting started 
 
 Enable the module 
 Configure your Backup and Migrate AWS S3 destination 
 Open the Deploy page at /admin/config/development/drupalforge-deploy 
 Follow the readiness steps to verify your configuration 
 Select a Git branch and backup, then click Deploy 
 
 For detailed setup instructions and troubleshooting, see the module documentation .

 
 AI disclosure 
 This module was developed with assistance from GitHub Copilot.
